actuals.label: SYNTHETIC_DEMO_DETERMINISTIC_BASELINE
actuals.note: Demand stays forecast-aligned by default. Asset execution can include small deterministic control/measurement variability configured separately below.

replacement_note: Replace demo simulation assumptions with utility-approved simulation configuration at deployment; never hard-code them in tools.

followup_forecast.label: SYNTHETIC_DEMO_ASSUMPTION
followup_forecast.note: After execution, issue a snapshot-owned solar/demand MW persistence forecast for the next planning horizon so repeated plan cycles remain valid.

execution_variability.label: SYNTHETIC_DEMO_NORMAL_CONTROL_VARIABILITY
execution_variability.note: Adds small deterministic per-asset differences between requested and actual power. With the shipped six-generator fleet, aggregate worst-case command variability remains below the 0.5 MW residual-balance tolerance while each asset remains below the 0.25 MW command-tracking tolerance.

dynamic_pricing_execution.label: SYNTHETIC_DEMO_DETERMINISTIC_FLEXIBLE_LOAD_RESPONSE
dynamic_pricing_execution.note: 1.0 executes the approved Tool 17 load shift exactly. Tests may override this factor in simulation_options to verify partial-response accounting while preserving source/target conservation.
